name: Differential privacy
summary: Dwork-McSherry-Nissim-Smith defined privacy through noise calibration.

name: Optimal transport and synthetic Ricci curvature
summary: Lower Ricci curvature bounds are defined on non-smooth spaces by convexity of entropy along optimal transport geodesics, giving a stable notion under Gromov-Hausdorff limits.

name: O-minimality in diophantine geometry (Pila-Wilkie, Pila-Zannier)
summary: Counting theorems for rational points on definable sets in o-minimal structures are combined with functional transcendence to prove Manin-Mumford and cases of Andre-Oort.

name: Mirzakhani moduli volumes
to: intersection theory on moduli of curves
summary: Mirzakhani computed Weil-Petersson volumes, recovered Witten's conjecture, and established Teichmuller-dynamics rigidity (with Eskin).

name: Graph limits and graphons
summary: Dense graph sequences were given analytic limit objects, unifying extremal combinatorics and statistical physics.

name: Compressed sensing
summary: Sparse signals are recovered exactly from few random measurements by l1 minimisation, using harmonic analysis and random matrices.

name: Boolean function analysis / invariance principle (Mossel-O'Donnell-Oleszkiewicz)
summary: An invariance principle transferred Gaussian results to low-influence Boolean functions, used to settle majority-is-stablest.

name: Gauge-theory heuristics for rational points (non-abelian Chabauty)
summary: Kim's programme uses spaces of path-collections on fundamental groups of curves, modelled on gauge-theory fields, in the hope of a least-action principle for finding rational solutions of Diophantine equations.

name: Periodic torus orbits, subconvexity and homogeneous dynamics
summary: Equidistribution of torus orbits on homogeneous spaces and subconvex bounds for L-functions are combined to prove equidistribution theorems for arithmetic objects.

name: Smirnov conformal invariance
summary: Smirnov proved conformal invariance of critical Ising and percolation using discrete holomorphicity.
